format.success: DDL 文の成功 (結果セットなし)
format.rows_affected: DML 文の成功 (count = 影響行数)
format.query: columns = 出力列名の順序付き配列 / rows = 列名をキーとするオブジェクトの配列 / 浮動小数点は有効数字 9 桁へ丸め / NULL は JSON null

statements.sql: CREATE TABLE users (id INT PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, region TEXT, age INT, score DOUBLE, active BOOLEAN)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (id INT PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, region TEXT, age INT, score DOUBLE, active BOOLEAN)
CREATE TABLE orders (id INT PRIMARY KEY, user_id INT NOT NULL, amount DOUBLE NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE products (id INT PRIMARY KEY, category TEXT NOT NULL, region TEXT, price DOUBLE, tag TEXT)
CREATE TABLE regions (id INT PRIMARY KEY, region TEXT UNIQUE, bonus DOUBLE)
CREATE TABLE docs (id INT PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT, embedding VECTOR(3, L2))
CREATE INDEX idx_orders_user_id ON orders (user_id) USING BTREE
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_orders_user_id ON orders (user_id) USING BTREE
CREATE INDEX idx_docs_embedding ON docs (embedding) USING HNSW WITH (m = 8, ef_construction = 32)
CREATE TABLE scratch (id INT PRIMARY KEY, note TEXT)
